facts.fact: The faltering pair at the bend of the line is a slight guard from Usha's riders, unnamed, paired with Vasu, a Kettamala spearman (his mother keeps ducks at Kalladi), at dusk; ch24 did not show this pairing. Her shape is low, quick and dark and goes unnamed. She is cut across the shoulder; Vasu drops under the share and the line gaps. Replaces F941.

The spear goes through under Devan's right collarbone and out at the back; his right hand is dead and will not close, so the two-finger marma strike he used on a raider captain before the garrison, his first since the lower ford, was his last. The shaft is broken off short by an unseen hand.
Neela takes scored welts on the ribs and shoulder in leopard shape, and Devan feels hook drags along his side, before the spear.
Vellan leaves his unbound post at the narrow place at the top of the cut to fill the gap; the narrow place is open behind the line when Devan loses consciousness.
